extracted.subtask_description: Advice on how to produce a short, non-technical, compelling version of a mathematical paper (a 'story' or tweet-sized abstract) that entices others to ask for details. Aimed at novice writers preparing public-friendly/concise exposition of their results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-technical, non-detailed version of your abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Imagine a non-technical and non-detailed version of the abstract of your paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce a distilled telling of the main idea without technicalities or detailed proofs; think of it as an abstract rewritten for a general or non-specialist listener. This is the core framing for the 'mathematical story' the author recommends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short, to-the-point, tweet-length
rubrics_metrics.description: It should be short, to the point, and straightforward enough to be a tweet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the story very concise — a single-line or tweet-sized tagline. Avoid extended exposition at this stage; brevity forces focusing on the essential insight or surprising hook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interesting enough to be retold
rubrics_metrics.description: Yet interesting enough for one person to want to tell it
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft the wording so another person would find it worth repeating to someone else — i.e., it has a memorable hook or punch that survives being passed along.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provokes curiosity / invites follow-up questions
rubrics_metrics.description: And for the listener curious enough to be asking for details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include just enough hints to make listeners curious to learn more. The goal is to leave gaps that prompt questions and lead people to seek the full story or paper (example contrast: Aesop's dry distillation vs. Terminator's hook).

rubrics_metrics.name: Distill to essentials; omit irrelevant specifics
rubrics_metrics.description: The names of these animals and the manner in which one lost to another are less relevant to the point, so the story is very dry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remove peripheral or colorful specifics that do not serve the central idea; preserve only those details that are necessary to convey the main point and to seed curiosity. Balance between too-dry abstraction and unnecessary detail.
